mcqs.question: In the context of petitions concerning the Bihar Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, which institution did the Supreme Court uphold as having the power to conduct the revision?
mcqs.explanation: The Supreme Court held that the Election Commission can conduct the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. The Supreme Court delivered the ruling, but it is not the institution empowered to conduct the revision; the Chief Justice of India and the Representation of the People Act, 1950 are also incorrect choices.
